parsed.restated: ∀ d : ℝ, 0 < d → d < (1 : ℝ) / 2 → MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryRate d ≤ MetricCodes.Hamming.variationalRate d ∧ MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryRate d ≤ MetricCodes.Johnson.variationalRate d
parsed.proof:
constructor
· intro h d hd hd'
  have := h hd hd'
  unfold MetricCodes.Johnson.combinedVariationalRate at this
  exact le_min_iff.mp this
· intro h d hd hd'
  unfold MetricCodes.Johnson.combinedVariationalRate
  exact le_min_iff.mpr (h d hd hd')
parsed.english: For every d with 0 < d < 1/2, the binary-code rate at relative distance d is at most the Hamming variational rate at d and also at most the Johnson variational rate at d.
parsed.why_clearer: It unfolds the `min` in `combinedVariationalRate` into two separate bounds, so it is clear that the binary rate must lie below both variational rates.
